sources.finding: The current reference defines raw as no adjustments and asof=- as disabling symbol mapping. The proposed requests explicitly use both.
The published aggregation and trade-condition rules define the bar construction; raw does not imply an immutable vendor archive.
The documented change adds optional spin-off adjustment and combined adjustment parameters. It is not identified as a change to the raw SPY price basis. The screen does not request those options.
Current index and bounded targeted searches for historical adjustment changes were checked. This was not an exhaustive audit of every release or provider revision since 2016.
Corporate-action processing has no documented creation-delay guarantee. An all-types response and quarterly dividend sanity checks do not certify absence of other events or adjustment changes.

conclusion: No known unresolved raw-SPY adjustment-basis change affecting the registered window was identified in these checked sources. A documented applicable change must stop collection or scoring until resolved under the registered rules.
limitations: This records a bounded human documentation review, not proof that no historical vendor change exists.
Undocumented changes, missing corporate actions and later vendor revisions cannot be excluded.
Approval 2 must identify this exact review and its limitations before any real collection.
